units.source_text: 二条院里处处打扫得干干净净，男女侍从人等都在恭候公子回驾。

en.t: Everywhere in the Nijo residence had been swept spotlessly clean, and the male and female attendants were all waiting respectfully for the young lord's return.

units.source_text: 几个上级侍女都换上新装，打扮得花枝招展。

en.t: Several senior ladies-in-waiting had changed into new clothes and were dressed in splendid, showy finery.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，回想左大臣邸内众侍女垂头丧气、闷坐无聊之状，觉得十分可怜。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw this, he thought back to the ladies-in-waiting at the Minister of the Left's residence, sitting dejected and listless, and felt deeply sorry for them.
